field.name: image
field.comment: The ID of the image filling the block (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: title
field.comment: The title displayed over the image

field.name: body
field.comment: The rich text displayed below the title, over the image

field.name: buttonText
field.comment: The text of the button (empty: no button is displayed, unless it links to something)

field.name: buttonExternalLink
field.comment: The URL the button links to: it's used only when buttonInternalLinkCID and buttonFileLinkID are 0

field.name: buttonInternalLinkCID
field.comment: The ID of the page the button links to (0 or NULL: it links to buttonFileLinkID or to buttonExternalLink)

field.name: buttonFileLinkID
field.comment: The ID of the file the button links to (0 or NULL: none): it's used only when buttonInternalLinkCID is 0

field.name: height
field.comment: The height of the block, as a percentage of the height of the window (0 or NULL: its contents decide)

field.name: buttonColor
field.comment: The color of the button, one of the colors of the theme of the site

field.name: buttonStyle
field.comment: empty: the button is drawn as usual; outline: it's outlined; link: it's drawn as a plain link

field.name: buttonSize
field.comment: empty: the button has its regular size; lg: it's large; sm: it's small

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the title: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p

field.name: icon
field.comment: The class names of the Font Awesome icon displayed in the button, for instance fas fa-air-freshener
